description: Makerere University On-Campus Mobility and Traffic Flow Dataset is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors MABLE ASHABA AHEBWA. "This dataset contains 100,000 synthesized mobility and traffic-flow records generated to simulate on-campus movement patterns at Makerere University. It captures interactions between different campus zones, including academic buildings, services, entry gates, and junctions. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
